bibliography.title: WebDevJudge: Evaluating (M)LLMs as Critiques for Web Development Quality

sections.title: Appendix B Details in WebDevJudge Construction
Appendix G The Use of Large Language Models

abstract_sentences.text: The paradigm of LLM-as-a-judge is emerging as a scalable and efficient alternative to human evaluation, demonstrating strong performance on well-defined tasks.

evidence.anchor: strong performance on well-defined tasks

abstract_sentences.text: However, its reliability in open-ended tasks with dynamic environments and complex interactions remains unexplored.

evidence.anchor: reliability in open-ended tasks remains unexplored

abstract_sentences.text: To bridge the gap, we introduce WebDevJudge, a systematic benchmark for assessing LLM-as-a-judge performance in web development, with support for both non-interactive evaluation based on static observations and continuous interactive evaluation with a dynamic web environment.

evidence.anchor: support for both non-interactive and continuous interactive evaluation

abstract_sentences.text: WebDevJudge comprises human preference labels over paired web implementations, annotated with structured and query-grounded rubrics to ensure high-quality ground truth.

evidence.anchor: human preference labels over paired web implementations

abstract_sentences.text: Using this benchmark, we comprehensively evaluate various evaluators, including LLMs, MLLMs, and agentic workflows.

evidence.anchor: including LLMs, MLLMs, and agentic workflows

abstract_sentences.text: We systematically investigate the impact of different paradigms and guidance mechanisms.

evidence.anchor: different paradigms and guidance mechanisms

abstract_sentences.text: Our experiments reveal a significant gap between LLM judges and human experts.

evidence.anchor: significant gap between LLM judges and human experts

abstract_sentences.text: In-depth analysis indicates this gap stems from fundamental model limitations, including failures in recognizing functional equivalence, verifying task feasibility, and mitigating bias.

evidence.anchor: recognizing functional equivalence, verifying task feasibility, and mitigating bias

abstract_sentences.text: Overall, WebDevJudge presents a challenge to LLM-as-a-judge, offering insights to guide future research toward developing more reliable and capable automated evaluators for complicated scenarios.

evidence.anchor: presents a challenge to LLM-as-a-judge

abstract_sentences.text: Code and data are available at https://github.com/lcy2723/WebDevJudge.

evidence.anchor: Code and data are available

introduction_moves.move: context: 以 evaluate–refine 循环和人类评测成本建立背景；上一段无问题，下一钩子是 LLM-as-a-judge。

evidence.anchor: critical bottleneck due to its high cost and low scalability

introduction_moves.move: problem: 说明既有自动 judge 的成功依赖 static final outcomes；回答上一段的可扩展性并钩向动态开放式场景。

evidence.anchor: inter-annotator agreement over 80%

introduction_moves.move: method_preview: 说明每个实现提供 code、rendered screenshot 与 fully interactive environment；钩向 paired preference。

evidence.anchor: source code, screenshot and a fully interactive environment

introduction_moves.move: method_preview: 规定 evaluator performance 以 expert preference agreement 衡量；钩向模型和 agent 实验。

evidence.anchor: agreement with expert human preferences

introduction_moves.move: result_preview: 预告广泛 evaluator、paradigm、guidance 覆盖；钩向约 15% gap。

evidence.anchor: comprehensive evaluation of a wide array of judges

introduction_moves.move: result_preview: 报告 advanced models 与 experts 约 15% discrepancy；钩向 guidance。

evidence.anchor: performance discrepancy of about 15%

introduction_moves.move: result_preview: 报告 pairwise guidance 只有 marginal improvement，并提出 preference 可能已内化；钩向 agentic workflow。

evidence.anchor: provide only marginal improvements in the pairwise comparison setting

evidence.anchor: fail to outperform vanilla models due to error accumulation

evidence.anchor: construct WebDevJudge-Unit, a diagnostic dataset

introduction_moves.move: result_preview: 具体化 functional equivalence 与 feasibility precision／recall 弱点；钩向 compounding errors。

evidence.anchor: static assessment suffers from low precision

introduction_moves.move: scope_boundary: 将复合错误定位为自动 judge reliability 根因，并把改进方向留给后续研究。

evidence.anchor: ultimately undermine evaluator performance

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 构造支持静态与交互评测且有高质量偏好标签的 benchmark；回收第 5–9 段。

evidence.anchor: supports both static and interactive assessment

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 广泛经验评估显示当前 judge 低于人类可靠性；回收第 10–13 段。

evidence.anchor: falls short of human-level reliability

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 错误分析识别系统弱点；回收第 14–16 段。

evidence.anchor: identifies the systematic weaknesses

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy + chronology: 先按 question answering、data filtering、trajectory evaluation 列应用，再从 conventional LLM-as-a-Judge 推进到 Agent-as-a-Judge；以 position／verbosity bias、rubric 成本和 final-outcome 偏重建立 prior limitation，最后定位 open-ended web benchmark。

evidence.anchor: position bias and verbosity preference may skew results

related_work_moves.move: nearest_neighbor_contrast + gap_creation: 将 meta-evaluation 分成 preference alignment 与 correct task outcome，再比较 MT-bench／LLMEval、LLM-Bar／JudgeBench、AgentRewardBench 与 ArtifactsBench 的文本、trajectory、视觉动态边界。

evidence.anchor: mainly focus on text-based tasks without complex environments

related_work_moves.move: credit_or_foundation + positioning_only: 承认已有 pairwise、rubric-tree、agent-as-judge 方向，引用在 §4 继续承载 bias、agent failure 与 observation 的论证，不重复 §3 的实现。

evidence.anchor: assesses judges on dynamic, real-world web development tasks

method_moves.move: state_problem → define_component：把 benchmark instance 定义为 `(Q, W_a, W_b, l_p)`，指定 query、双 implementation、三值 preference 与可变 observation。

evidence.anchor: Each instance is represented as a quadruple

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm：从 10,501 条 webdev-arena-preference-10k paired outputs 出发，规定 query-based 与 environment-based 两阶段过滤。

evidence.anchor: We apply a two-stage filtering process

method_moves.move: define_component：query filter 移除极短／逐字重复 query，并按 safety、clarity、feasibility 筛选。

evidence.anchor: Safety, Clarity, Feasibility

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism：统一环境部署实现，丢弃 deployment／niche dependency 失败，并用 initial screenshot 的 MLLM 检查 blank page／intrinsic error。

evidence.anchor: capture initial screenshots of each rendered webpage

method_moves.move: derive：用 100 个实例的重标显示原始 preference 的主观性，随后提出沿 intention、static quality、dynamic behavior 组织的 query-based rubric tree。

evidence.anchor: organized along three core dimensions

method_moves.move: define_component → connect_to_prediction：每个 leaf 是 binary test，向上汇总 root score，并保留 leaf-level pass rate 做 diagnosis。

evidence.anchor: Each leaf node corresponds to a binary test

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm → connect_to_experiment：用 few-shot LLM 自动生成 rubric，第三 annotator 对照 human-written rubric，再由两位 software-engineering experts 标注剩余数据。

evidence.anchor: Final inter-annotator agreement on a sampled subset reaches 89.7%

method_moves.move: summarize：统计最终 654 instances、a=269、b=276、tie=109，并按三大 query category 给 coverage。

evidence.anchor: The final benchmark consists of 654 instances

experimental_design.name: dataset_and_sampling
experimental_design.description: 从 10,501 个 paired outputs 经两阶段过滤到 1,713，再 sample 700 并人工过滤到 654；最终标签为 a、b、tie。

experimental_design.name: query_and_environment_controls
experimental_design.description: query filter 控制 duplicate、safety、clarity、feasibility；environment filter 控制 deployment、dependency、status code、blank screenshot。

experimental_design.name: evaluation_paradigms
experimental_design.description: 比较 pairwise comparison 与 single answer grading；preference 标签为 a、b 或 tie。

claim_closure.claim: WebDevJudge simultaneously benchmarks static and interactive web-quality preference.
claim_closure.method_response: §3 defines `(Q, W_a, W_b, l_p)` and supplies code, screenshot and interactive observations; rubric tree creates query-grounded labels.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 1, Table 1, 654-instance statistics and agentic workflow operationalize the two observation modes.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 restates support for static code analysis and interactive agent navigation.

evidence.anchor: observations ... such as code, screenshots, or interaction trajectories
supports both static code analysis and interactive agent navigation

claim_closure.method_response: Two-stage filtering, query-grounded tree, binary leaves and expert annotation address subjective raw labels.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1 reports 65.0/53.0 without rubric versus 92.0/90.0 with rubric (with tie); sampled final agreement is 89.7%.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 refers to high-quality preference labels but does not repeat the numbers.

evidence.anchor: rubric-guided annotation significantly improves agreement rates

claim_closure.claim: Current judges fall short of human-level reliability.
claim_closure.method_response: Pairwise and single protocols include a human pairwise baseline.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 3 gives GPT-4.1 pairwise 70.34% versus human 84.56%; Table 14 without ties retains the same ordering.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 explicitly states current approaches cannot effectively substitute human evaluation.

evidence.anchor: Human Pairwise comparison 84.56
cannot effectively substitute human evaluation

claim_closure.claim: Pairwise is more reliable than single and pairwise guidance gains are marginal.
claim_closure.method_response: Direct、Likert、Rubric are evaluated under both paradigms with common query／implementation inputs.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 3, Figure 3 and Table 14 show pairwise gains and close pairwise guidance variants.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Result subsection makes the claim; §5 does not restate it as a separate sentence.

evidence.anchor: pairwise paradigm yields an average improvement of over 8.0%
marginal benefits in relative assessment settings

claim_closure.claim: Agentic workflow errors compound across planning, execution and summarization.

final_judgment.single_storyline: LLM judge reliability is tested beyond static text through a dynamic, open-ended web-development preference benchmark; rubric-grounded labels and multiple observations expose a human gap and three bottlenecks.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Benchmark definition, filtering and label quality, model/paradigm setup, human baseline, main agreement matrix, guidance/modality controls, bias, feasibility, ensemble and explicit conclusion boundary remain in the main body.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Filtering prompts and counts, annotation guidelines, rubric statistics, 13 Likert subcriteria, API/temperature/action space, Unit error taxonomy, swap/no-tie consistency, case studies and LLM disclosure move to Appendices A–G.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Query-grounded binary leaves plus a cross-modal Figure 1 pipeline and compact contrast tables connect an open-ended quality notion to verifiable tasks and concrete failure cases.
final_judgment.largest_gap: Agent compounding-error and functional-equivalence mechanisms rely on aggregate scores or illustrative cases; no stage-level intervention, component deletion, prevalence or uncertainty is reported.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For interactive open-ended evaluation, pair relative preference with atomic executable checks and preserve diagnosis that separates literal mismatch, execution failure and genuine quality differences.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: This rule transfers to web/GUI/agent tasks with live state and query-grounded tests; it does not establish cross-domain reliability when execution or trustworthy preference labels are unavailable.

lexical_profile.basis: Contextual annotation of p. 1–10 main text after excluding references, formula fragments, table numbers and repeated headers; not a replacement for the project lexical script.

claim_verbs.identify/reveal: 结果与 error analysis；提出 gap、bias、equivalence、feasibility。
claim_verbs.show/demonstrate: 多用于图表结果或 rubric agreement，不对应 theorem proof。
claim_verbs.leave: §5；将复杂 agentic workflow 与 multi-round evaluation 留给 future work。

lexical_profile.strong_weak_balance: 强主张集中在 abstract、introduction 与结果小标题（fundamental/significant/comprehensive/cannot effectively substitute）；机制解释多用 appears、may、suggests、often。此处保留形态差异，不把表格标题计作主张。
lexical_profile.segmentation_risks: PDF 文本提取把 WebDevJudge、LLM-as-a-judge、复合词和跨行连字符拆开；同一词的 singular/plural 与 hyphenated/unhyphenated 形式需由汇总器统一。
